# dsh-office-bridge
English | 简体中文
> 中文简介：你和 AI 智能体在 DSH 侧边栏里编辑同一个 Office 文件，保存直接写回原文件——不上传、不转格式。完整中文文档见 README.zh-CN.md。

**You and your AI agent edit the same Office file in the DSH sidebar — ONLYOFFICE
does the heavy lif

ting, saves land back on the original file, no uploading files
around.**

- Supported formats: `.xlsx` / `.xls` / `.csv` / `.tsv` / `.docx` / `.pptx`
- Platform: sidebar plug

in for **DSH Desktop (Windows)**
- License: **MIT** (this plugin). The editing engine, ONLYOFFICE Do

cument
Server, is a separate product under **AGPLv3 / commercial dual licensing —
you install it you

rself and accept its license yourself**.
- Zero runtime dependencies. Source is the artifact; no bui

d accept its license yourself**.
- Zero runtime dependencies. Source is the artifact; no build step.

> **The editing engine is not part of this plugin.** This plugin is an
> MIT-licensed, zero-dependen

cy integration layer and contains **no ONLYOFFICE
> Document Server code**. You must download and in

stall ONLYOFFICE Document
> Server for Windows yourself (installer is about 873 MB), and read and ac

cept
> its AGPLv3 or commercial license terms before installing.
## What it does

Click an Office file in a DSH session and the right sidebar opens an ONLYOFFICE
editor tab:

- **Original-format edit and write-back** — no shadow files, no format
conversion. The file you edit

is the file on disk.
- **Disk changes always ask first** — when the file changes on disk (for
examp

le by an AI agent or a script), the editor shows a banner instead of
reloading by itself: "The file

was modified on disk (possibly by AI)" with a
Reload button. Your unsaved edits are never thrown awa

y without you clicking
it. This is deliberate — ONLYOFFICE does not report edit state reliably
enoug

h to distinguish "you have unsaved work" from "you do not".
- **Backup before write-back** — every s

ave keeps the previous version as
`filename.ext.bak` in the same directory.
- **Security hardening**

— write-back URLs are restricted to the configured
DS address (loopback by default); `fileLimitMb`

size cap (default 100 MB);
the local exchange service binds to 127.0.0.1 only; HMAC token validation

on
download URLs. See `SECURITY.md`.
- **Session persistence** — opened files are recorded in regis

try.json (max
128 entries) and restored after a DSH restart.
### ⚠️ Write-back behavior (read this)

- **Save timing**: ONLYOFFICE sends the content back when you **close the
document tab** (or save ma

nually); this plugin then writes the file.
- **Whole-file overwrite**: write-back **replaces the ent

ire file**. No merge.
- **Automatic .bak**: each write-back first stores the old version as
`filenam

e.ext.bak` in the same directory. **Only the most recent previous
version is kept** — a second save

overwrites it.
- **Close the tab before restarting DSH.** Unsave content lives in the
ONLYOFFICE ser

ver and reaches this plugin by callback. If DSH is restarting,
the callback has nowhere to land and

the edit is lost (the server retries
briefly, then gives up with `backoff limit exceeded`). Save/clo

se first.
- **Keep your own backups or version control for important files.** The risk
of write-back
overwrite is the user's own.
## Prerequisites

1. **DSH Desktop (Windows)** — this is a DSH Desktop sidebar plugin.
2. **ONLYOFFICE Document Server

GPLv3 / commercial dual licensing. **Installing it and
accepting its license are your own decision a

ation table.
3. Put this package into the DSH desktop profile
(`profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-of

fice-bridge/`), add
`"dsh-office-bridge"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile
`package.json`, an
d restart DSH Desktop.
### JWT configuration

When DS enables JWT, the plugin **auto-detects** the secret from DS's
`C:\Program Files\ONLYOFFICE\D

ocumentServer\config\local.json`
(zero-dependency HS256 implementation, cached on file mtime). If de

tection
fails, tokens are omitted. You can also set `dsSecret` manually.
## Configuration (profile config, all optional)
| Key | Default | Description |
| `office-bridge.dsBaseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:80` | DS address (also the base of the write-back UR

L allow-list); change if port 80 is taken |
| `office-bridge.bridgePort` | `17890` | Local file-exch

ange port; auto +1 retry up to 10 times if taken |
| `office-bridge.dsSecret` | auto-detect | Manual

JWT secret |
| `office-bridge.lang` | `zh-CN` | Editor language; fallback chain zh-CN → zh → en |
|

`office-bridge.defaultMode` | `edit` | `edit` (editable) / `view` (read-only preview) |
| `office-b
ridge.fileLimitMb` | `100` | File size limit (oversize refuses download / write-back) |
## Troubleshooting

- `GET /office-bridge/api/health` — `dsReachable`, actual `bridgePort`, `jwt`
status, version.
- `GE

T /office-bridge/api/config` — effective configuration.
- If the editor page fails to load, the page

title gets an `ERR-` prefix. If
the sidebar shows "cannot open editor", check that DS is running, t

s an `ERR-` prefix. If
the sidebar shows "cannot open editor", check that DS is running, then retry.
## Difference from dsh-sidebar-onlyoffice

The community also has `dsh-sidebar-onlyoffice` (a plugin for dsh web
deployments). This project tar

gets **DSH Desktop**: files are on local disk,
edits write straight back to the original file, no up

load/download step, plus
disk-change banners, .bak backups, and registry session restore.
If you run
dsh as a web service, use that project instead.
## License and trademarks

- This plugin is released under **MIT** (see `LICENSE`) and contains no source
code from ONLYOFFICE

Document Server.
- **ONLYOFFICE is a trademark of Ascensio System SIA.** This project is not
affilia

ted with, or endorsed by, ONLYOFFICE / Ascensio System SIA.
- No telemetry: this plugin collects and

uploads nothing. All communication
stays between local processes.
